backstory:
Luigi comes from a long line of Italian Chefs famed for their traditional Italian cuisine. Frankly, his decision to devote himself entirely to pizza has led to him being disowned by his family. After learning of his large inheritance being revoked his wife left him and took the kids. Despites all this, Luigi is a very happy man. He finally can devote himself to his life long passion rather than making any Italian cuisine.


Luigi Stefano is the beloved pizza man owner of Luigi’s pizzeria, a Pesci  family favorite. Luigi is a boisterous man who tends to speak more with his body language and hands than his mouth. Although nothing can surpass his love of anything pizza related, he tends to love a good hotspring or sauna as well.


Once upon a time, a young Luigi Stefano took a vacation at a hot spring and snuck in a homemade pizza. This was one of the greatest moments in his life, but it was ruined when dropped the pizza in the scalding water. This is when Luigi learned an important life lesson, there are some places where pizza shouldn’t be brought.


Luigi cares not about simple things like morality, all he cares about is making the best pizza and having as many people enjoy it as possible. He has a soft spot for Giuseppi Pesci Jr. because of his pure unadulterated joy when it comes to Luigi’s pizza.


Also, 25% of pizza for the Jemand family. Who wouldn’t want to take this deal.
